newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical fibre demand up 13-14 pct by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China chemical fibre demand up 13-14 pct by 2000.

text.p: China's demand for raw materials to manufacture chemical fibres is seen growing by 13-14 percent from 1997 to the year 2000, the China Chemical Industry News said on Tuesday.
Demand for eight major types of raw materials used to produce chemical fibres would be about 8.4 million tonnes by 2000, the newspaper said.
Domestic supply was seen slightly short of production, the newspaper said.
Production of the major raw materials would grow by 14-15 percent a year through the end of the century, boosting output by more 4.0 million tonnes to more than 8.0 million tonnes, it said.
